question: What software was used in campaign 'C0026: C0026'?
answer_text:
Gathered 1 record(s) from 1 source(s).
Found ATT&CK record C0026: C0026. C0026 (C0026): C0026 was a campaign identified in September 2022 that included the selective distribution of KOPILUWAK and QUIETCANARY malware to previous ANDROMEDA malware victims in Ukraine through re-registered ANDROMEDA C2 domains. Several tools and tactics used during C0026 were consistent with historic Turla operations.(Citation: Mandiant Suspected Turla Campaign February 2023).
